description: This file is a PHP script that provides a web interface for users to change their passwords. It includes HTML for the form, JavaScript for client-side validation and interactivity, and PHP includes for header, footer, and session management. The core functionality involves validating user input, toggling password visibility, and sending password change requests to the server via AJAX.

methods.name: getInstanceNum
methods.description: Determines the user instance number based on the current session's username.

methods.name: cancel_save
methods.description: Redirects the user to the 'at_a_glance.php' page, canceling the password change process.

methods.name: set_config
methods.description: Sends a configuration change request via AJAX to update the password and handles success/failure responses.

methods.name: next_step
methods.description: Validates the new password inputs and initiates the password change process by calling set_config.
